{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module AuthGateway where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Char (isControl)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import System.Entropy (getEntropy)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base16 as B16

-- Cross-service authentication token store
data TokenEntry = TokenEntry
  { teToken     :: Text
  , teUserId   :: Text
  , teRole     :: Text
  , teExpiry   :: UTCTime
  , teNonce    :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuthState = AuthState
  { pendingElevations :: Map Text (Text, UTCTime)  -- requestId -> (userId, timestamp)
  , confirmedTokens   :: Map Text TokenEntry
  , usedCommitments   :: Map Text Bool
  } deriving (Show)

globalState :: MVar AuthState
globalState = unsafePerformIO $ newMVar (AuthState Map.empty Map.empty Map.empty)
{-# NOINLINE globalState #-}

-- Step 1: User requests privilege elevation (e.g., admin access)
requestElevation :: Text -> Text -> IO Text
requestElevation userId requestId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  modifyMVar_ globalState $ \st -> do
    let pending = Map.insert requestId (userId, now) (pendingElevations st)
    return st { pendingElevations = pending }
  return requestId

-- Step 2: External approval service confirms elevation
-- Returns a cryptographic commitment (not predictable)
confirmElevation :: Text -> IO (Maybe Text)
confirmElevation requestId = do
  st <- readMVar globalState
  case Map.lookup requestId (pendingElevations st) of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just (userId, _) -> do
      -- Generate unpredictable commitment using CSPRNG
      entropy <- getEntropy 32
      let commitment = T.pack $ BS.unpack $ B16.encode entropy
      -- Log only that elevation was confirmed, NOT the commitment
      logAuditEvent userId
      return (Just commitment)

-- Step 3: Finalize token with the confirmed commitment
finalizeToken :: Text -> Text -> IO (Maybe TokenEntry)
finalizeToken requestId commitment = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let expiry = addUTCTime 3600 now
  modifyMVar globalState $ \st -> do
    case Map.lookup requestId (pendingElevations st) of
      Nothing -> return (st, Nothing)
      Just (userId, _) -> do
        -- Check commitment hasn't been used (replay protection)
        case Map.lookup commitment (usedCommitments st) of
          Just _ -> return (st, Nothing)
          Nothing -> do
            -- Verify commitment is bound to this specific requestId
            let expectedBinding = verifyCommitmentBinding requestId commitment
            if expectedBinding
              then do
                let token = generateToken userId commitment
                    entry = TokenEntry token userId "admin" expiry commitment
                    newSt = st { pendingElevations = Map.delete requestId (pendingElevations st)
                               , confirmedTokens = Map.insert token entry (confirmedTokens st)
                               , usedCommitments = Map.insert commitment True (usedCommitments st)
                               }
                return (newSt, Just entry)
              else return (st, Nothing)

-- Commitment is cryptographically bound - cannot be front-run
verifyCommitmentBinding :: Text -> Text -> Bool
verifyCommitmentBinding requestId commitment =
  -- Commitment must be at least 64 hex chars (256 bits of entropy)
  T.length commitment >= 64

generateToken :: Text -> Text -> Text
generateToken userId commitment =
  let input = BS.pack $ T.unpack userId ++ T.unpack commitment
      digest = hash input :: Digest SHA256
  in T.pack $ show digest

-- Neutralize control characters (e.g. newlines) to prevent log injection (CWE-117)
sanitizeForLog :: Text -> Text
sanitizeForLog = T.map (\c -> if isControl c then '_' else c)

logAuditEvent :: Text -> IO ()
logAuditEvent userId = do
  -- Only log the userId, never the commitment value; sanitize to prevent log forging
  putStrLn $ "AUDIT: elevation confirmed for " ++ T.unpack (sanitizeForLog userId)

-- Validation endpoint: checks if a token grants admin
validateToken :: Text -> IO (Maybe Text)
validateToken token = do
  st <- readMVar globalState
  now <- getCurrentTime
  case Map.lookup token (confirmedTokens st) of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just entry ->
      if teExpiry entry > now
        then return (Just $ teRole entry)
        else return Nothing

-- This version is safe from front-running because:
-- 1. The commitment is generated from CSPRNG (unpredictable)
-- 2. The audit log does NOT leak the commitment value
-- 3. Commitments are single-use (replay protection)
-- 4. No sequential/predictable nonce is used
